messages:
Ravi K.: Hey folks, FYI I tweaked my typing last week but my ulnar neuropathy flared again. Doc recommends minimizing repetitive wrist flexion for ~8 weeks. Could request a temporary accommodation: limit bulk incident typing and shift me to coordinator/reviewer role during oncall.
Carmen - Eng Lead: Sorry to hear that, Ravi. Totally fine — thanks for sharing. Can you outline which activities you want to avoid vs what you can still do? helps us map coverage.
Ravi K.: Avoid: long terminal sessions, heavy keyboard remediation, long-fledged code edits during incidents. OK: answering via calls/screenshare, reading runbooks, coordinating, declaiming steps verbally, writing short triage notes.
Lena (People Ops): Thanks for the details. We can support a short-term duty reassignment as an accommodation. Two admin items: 1) medical note (brief ok) to people-ops@redwood.com or DM to me; 2) we'll draft a private coverage plan and liaise with Eng to update PagerDuty. We'll also arrange a loaner ergonomic keyboard and a 20-min posture consult if helpful.
Ravi K.: I'll email a short physio note today. Appreciate the ergonomic keyboard offer — that would help.
Aria (IT): Noted. We have a few Kinesis & vertical keyboard models in stock. If you confirm model preference (kinesis or ergo), we can ship next-day.
Carmen - Eng Lead: For oncall, we can label a "reduced-typing" rota and assign a keyboard buddy for any heavy remediation. Jake and Mei — can you folks pick up keyboard-heavy pages while Ravi triages?
Oncall Bot: @Jake S. and @Mei L. added to coverage for Ravi's reduced-typing windows.
Ravi K.: Thanks. Proposed timeline:
Week 1-4: no keyboard remediation during oncall; act as coordinator/triage/reviewer only
Week 5-8: gradual reintroduction to remediation as tolerated
I'll DM Lena when the note is sent.
Lena (People Ops): That timeline works. I'll prepare a private doc with the accommodation plan, shipping timeline for the keyboard, and check-ins at week 2 and week 4. We'll mark the accommodation as temporary and confidential.
Carmen - Eng Lead: I'll update PagerDuty and the runbook labels. Ravi, we'll make sure any escalations that would require long typing are routed to the keyboard buddy.
Ravi K.: Really grateful for the quick support. Also, can you confirm whether time off for physio appointments will be covered under flexible appointments?
Lena (People Ops): Yes — use "medical appointment" time-off when scheduling physio; it's approved and won't count against vacation. If you need extra flex time, let us know and we can formalize.
Ravi K.: Great, will do. Thanks everyone.
Aria (IT): Ravi, reply here with preferred keyboard model and delivery address and I'll queue shipment.
Oncall Bot: Accommodation logged (ID: AC-2026-211). People Ops will follow up within 2 business days.
Lena (People Ops): I'll close out after the private doc is shared and we get the medical note. Thanks team for the coverage.
Carmen - Eng Lead: Thank you Ravi for flagging early. Team: please keep this private and avoid sharing medical details outside the private doc.
Ravi K.: Closing the loop — I sent the note to people-ops@redwood.com and picked Kinesis as the keyboard. Appreciate the support.
